# Frontend standards
<!-- Generated by project-init v0.4.1. Details and reasons: docs/standards/frontend.md -->

## Adopting
- Give every input widget a meaningful label through `t()`. To hide it visually, use `label_visibility="collapsed"`, never an empty label.
- Never show status by colour alone: health and escalation badges always include the label text.
- Format dates and numbers for the selected language through the i18n layer, not with fixed format strings.
- Pages and components only display data and collect input. Calculations live in `domain`.
